title: SVP Anchor
description: A three-dimensional evidence anchor in the SwarmLabs Verification Protocol.

label.description: Human-readable name of the anchored quantity

unit.description: Physical unit of the anchored value

lo.description: Lower bound of the declared range (null if unbounded)

hi.description: Upper bound of the declared range (null if unbounded)

sources.description: Citations with year or DOI (N8 gate requires checkable citations)

scenarios.description: Scenario IDs this anchor applies to

value_key.description: Key in the scenario's implicit parameter dict that this anchor anchors

decision_relevant.description: If true, this anchor is used for automated decision-making; must be 3D complete

note.description: Free-form notes on this anchor's provenance or caveats

evidence_completeness.description: Computed from evidence field. Gates N31-N33 enforce 3D_complete for DR anchors.
